Maya R.: Heads-up — onboarding MistralX-12B (int4) vs Qwen-7B baseline. We're seeing reproducible quality diffs on longctx summarization. Symptoms look like headscale / sparse-proj interaction, not just quant noise.
Samir: Can you share the eval command and tokenizer checks? Tokenization granularity often bites here.
Maya R.: Tokenizer checksum matches the Qwen export (sha256 same). Eval command I ran: ```
./run_eval.sh --model mistralx-12b-int4 --baseline qwen-7b --task summarization --max_len 2048 --batch 4
```
Linh: Do a kv-cache alignment check too — rotary/kv handshake + headwise scaling mismatches look similar.
Maya R.: KV cache pointers look fine. Found something else though: sparse projection matrix export order differs. MistralX export packs sparse_proj as (out_dim, in_dim) while our loader assumed (in_dim, out_dim). I opened a tiny repro in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1234
Oliver: That would definitely amplify quant error. Try forcing that proj to fp32 before running as a quick test: ```
python - <<'PY'
from loaders import load_model, save_model
m = load_model('mistralx-12b-int4')
m.sparse_proj = m.sparse_proj.float()
save_model(m, 'mistralx-fp32-proj.pt')
PY
```
bench-bot: EvalJob 1777777777 finished 12h run — metrics: rougeL_mistral=21.3, rougeL_qwen=24.9, avg_latency_mistral=82ms, avg_latency_qwen=68ms
Samir: >3 rouge delta is actionable. If proj order is wrong, rotary scaling params (rotary_factor/headscale) can end up applied off-by-head and cause resonance. Check config key `rotary.headwise_scaling`.
Linh: I can repro locally with your script, starting a bisect between (proj-order swap) and (int4 kernel variant). Will post minimal failing sample. :thumbsup:
Maya R.: Awesome — please @me with the sample. Meanwhile adding a temporary routing fallback to Qwen for our summarization route until we have a patch.
Oliver: Note for runbook: if proj-order mismatch is detected, Console should auto-flag embedding-drift and recommend a small dequant/regression test. Filing ticket after bisect.
Linh: update: initial bisect points to export ordering + amplified by per-head rotary_scale != 1.0. Trying a patch that swaps proj dims then re-applies quant packing.
Maya R.: Thanks team — keep updates here. If we confirm, we should add a conversion sanity check to the convert tool that asserts proj shape and rotary config.
